comparison.objective: Correct a drifting conveyor belt using tail take-up adjustments.
comparison.physical_skill: Diagnose drift and make incremental fastener adjustments limited to a quarter turn per two belt revolutions.
comparison.success_condition: Belt returns to center while respecting the adjustment-rate limit; other thresholds are unavailable.
comparison.reason: Closed-loop belt tracking and slow screw adjustment are different from stabilizing a mandrel during hammer impact and recovering fractured tangs.
